g.text: Prompt as Code: YAML config stored in Git
50+ canonical test cases covering edge cases, OOD, regression
● A/B test framework with statistical significance (p < 0.05)
⚠ Drift Alert: Token count + refusal rate
● Alert triggers when metric crosses threshold
Store in Git — every change is traceable and reversible
Use embedding similarity to cache & reuse responses
Route simple queries to cheaper model
Monitor refusal rate as proxy for quality
Spike usually means prompt regression or drift
Regression suite in CI/CD — gate on pass/fail
